title: OpenReceive Verified Payment Event
description: In-process JS callback payload (camelCase) delivered to the host onPaid hook. This is deliberately NOT a wire schema: HTTP bodies are snake_case and are described by the OpenAPI document and error.schema.json. It describes the serializable event only — db-mode onPaid additionally receives a `query` handle bound to the settlement transaction, which is a runtime capability rather than event data and is therefore not modelled here.
